The '''Indra-su-Mar sector''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Expansion" /> It contained the [[Farfalla system/Legends|Farfalla system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Indra-su-Mar [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Authala sector/Legends|Authala sector]] [[spinward]], the [[Ombakond sector/Legends|Ombakond sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], and the [[Dimean sector/Legends|Dimean sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The northwestern portion of the sector was also adjacent to the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] and the [[Nuon e Safyd sector/Legends|Nuon e Safyd sector]], and together with the Authala and Dimean sectors, it formed the Expansion Region's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border, neighboring the [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Indra-su-Mar sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]." It was placed in grid squares P-12 and P-13.<ref name="Expansion" />
